summaryTo: Sent to the Bondi night team

lines.text: Hi, you've called Corella Hotels. I'm Corella's AI agent, and this call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi. I'm booked at Corella Bondi tonight, but my flight's delayed. I won't get in till about eleven.
No trouble at all. What's the name on the booking?
Thanks, Tom. I've got you in an Ocean Room tonight. Reception's open all night, so eleven is fine. I've noted that you're arriving late.
Great. Any chance of something to eat when I get in?
The kitchen closes at ten, but I can ask the night team to leave a cheese plate in your room. Would you like that?

act.text: Cheese plate requested from the night team

lines.text: Done. I'll text you the late check-in details now. Safe travels, Tom.

act.text: Late check-in details texted to Tom
